claude_proposed_widenings.name: take_standard_action_as_bonus_action
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The trait's core mechanic is an action-economy remap: spending a bonus action to perform the Dash action itself. The current surface can encode the bonus-action activation, PB-scaled use count, short-or-long-rest reset, and the temporary HP rider, but it cannot represent the Dash action payload honestly. `grant_extra_action` is not equivalent because it grants an additional action, not a bonus-action Dash.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. When you do so, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus."

discrepancies: no content/species_orc_adrenaline_rush.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
